**PROTOCOLS AND ALGORITHMS (Document 227)** is a specification by **Sparrow Wells** and Lee Sharks dated 3 February 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

Sparrow Wells is the Dodecad's **Projectionist**, the seventh heteronym, whose domain is the Studio for Patacinematics chartered at #1312. A protocols-and-algorithms document under that voice specifies the operational layer of a cinematic institution — the procedures by which projection, sequence and screening are governed.

The deposit is marked **ZP with attached .md**, one of the archive's transport notations from the Zenodo era, recording that the packet carried an attached markdown file alongside its metadata. The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface passing the body-head gate at restoration time.
